title: Appendices
body:
## A. Financial Tables

Five-year consolidated income statement (FY3/21–FY3/26E), segment revenue and operating profit, balance-sheet snapshot at March 2025 and December 2025, FY3/26 full-year guidance versus nine-month actuals, and FY3/29 medium-term targets. All figures in JPY millions unless noted; USD/EUR conversions at period-average rates.

## B. Corporate Timeline

Key dates from founding (19 June 1889) through the 2014 Thailand restructuring attempt, the November 2024 withdrawal announcement, the April 2025 REVIC capital injection, and the December 2025 DIC–Unitika PPS film partnership. Milestones drawn from company filings, press releases, and contemporaneous news sources.

## C. Press-Release Index

Chronological register of all English-language investor disclosures published on unitika.co.jp between November 2024 and 22 May 2026, including quarterly earnings releases, the November 2025 company-split notice, the Unitika Report 2025, and the unprocessed April 2026 PDF release. URLs included.

## D. Counterparty Register

Divestiture buyers (Seiren, Shikibo, Zuiko, and unconfirmed parties), joint-development partners (DIC Corporation), creditor banks approving up to ¥43 billion in debt forgiveness (MUFG, Mizuho, Sumitomo Mitsui Trust), and majority shareholder REVIC with instrument details.

## E. Sources and Attribution Notes

Primary sources: Unitika investor-relations filings, REVIC official page, Nikkei, Jiji, Senken, Chemical Daily, Nonwovens Industry, BusinessWire. Secondary sources flagged where primary verification was unavailable.
